title: Proverbs Chapter 15 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 15 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 15 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 15.

questions.question: What type of answer does Proverbs 15:1 say turneth away wrath?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:1 states that 'A soft answer turneth away wrath', indicating that gentle responses can diffuse anger.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:2, what does the tongue of the wise use?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:2 mentions that 'The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright', highlighting the wise use of knowledge.

questions.question: True or False: The eyes of the LORD are only on the good according to Proverbs 15:3.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:3 says, 'The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good', indicating He sees both.

questions.question: What is a wholesome tongue compared to in Proverbs 15:4?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:4 states that 'A wholesome tongue is a tree of life', symbolizing its positive and life-giving nature.

questions.question: In Proverbs 15:5, who is described as prudent?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:5 highlights that 'he that regardeth reproof is prudent', emphasizing the value of accepting correction.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 15:6 states that trouble is found in the house of the righteous.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:6 says, 'In the house of the righteous is much treasure', indicating abundance and not trouble.

questions.question: What do the lips of the wise do according to Proverbs 15:7?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:7 states that 'The lips of the wise disperse knowledge', showing the wise share understanding.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:8, what is an abomination to the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:8 clarifies that 'The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD', emphasizing the value of uprightness.

questions.question: True or False: The way of the wicked is pleasing to the LORD according to Proverbs 15:9.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:9 states, 'The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD', indicating disfavor.

questions.question: What happens to a man who forsaketh the way according to Proverbs 15:10?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:10 reveals that 'he that hateth reproof shall die', warning against rejecting correction.

questions.question: In Proverbs 15:11, what is before the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:11 states, 'Hell and destruction are before the LORD', indicating His awareness of all things.

questions.question: True or False: A scorner loves those who reprove him according to Proverbs 15:12.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:12 states that 'A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him', indicating scorners avoid correction.

questions.question: In Proverbs 15, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: The way of the slothful man
A soft answer turneth away wrath
The heart of him that hath understanding
questions.correctAnswer: A soft answer turneth away wrath
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:1 is the first instruction in the chapter, setting the tone for the wisdom shared.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:13, what does a merry heart make?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:13 teaches that 'A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance', emphasizing the joy it brings.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 15 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 15 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:12, why does a scorner not go to the wise?
options: He loves not one that reproveth him
questions.correctAnswer: He loves not one that reproveth him
questions.explanation: A scorner does not appreciate correction and thus avoids wise counsel. Proverbs 15:12 clearly states that a scorner loveth not one that reproveth him, indicating his disdain for reproof.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:15 say about those who are of a merry heart?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:15 states that he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast, signifying that a positive disposition can lead to a joyful and fulfilling life.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:16, what is better than great treasure?
options: Little with the fear of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Little with the fear of the LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:16 emphasizes that better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith, highlighting the value of humility and reverence for God over material wealth.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:21 say about a man of understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:21 asserts that a man of understanding walketh uprightly, contrasting him with the foolish who find joy in folly, thereby promoting integrity in conduct.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:19, how is the way of the slothful man depicted?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:19 describes the way of the slothful man as a hedge of thorns, illustrating the difficulties and obstacles faced due to laziness, in contrast to the righteous who have a clear path.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 15:18 describe a wrathful man?
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 15:18, a wrathful man stirreth up strife, indicating that anger leads to conflict, while a person who is slow to anger can help to calm situations.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:14 say about the heart of a person with understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:14 states that the heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge, demonstrating the pursuit of wisdom as a characteristic of understanding.

questions.question: In Proverbs 15:22, what is said about purposes without counsel?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:22 indicates that without counsel, purposes are disappointed, signifying the importance of seeking advice and wisdom in planning.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 15:30 states that a good report maketh the bones fat.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:30 indeed states that a good report maketh the bones fat, emphasizing the positive effects of good news on one's well-being.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 15:27, he that is greedy of gain shall prosper.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:27 actually states that he that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house, indicating that greed leads to negative consequences rather than prosperity.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 15:33 teaches that humility comes before honor.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:33 teaches that before honour is humility, asserting that humility is essential for achieving true honor.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:10 warn about those who forsake the way?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:10 warns that correction is grievous to him that forsaketh the way, and he that hateth reproof shall die, emphasizing the danger of ignoring wisdom and instruction.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 15 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 15.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:23 say about the joy of a man?
options: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth
A man is sad by the answer of his mouth
A man hath joy in silence
A man is wise in his words
questions.correctAnswer: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:23 states that 'A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth', emphasizing the delight that comes from wise and timely speech.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:30, what brings joy to the heart?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:30 indicates that 'the light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat', highlighting the positive impact of good news on a person's spirit.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:29 say about the LORD's relationship with the wicked?
options: The LORD is close to the wicked
The LORD is far from the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD is far from the wicked
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:29 states, 'The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous', indicating a distance the LORD maintains from those who do evil.

questions.question: Which verse states that 'the fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom'?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:33 declares, 'The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility', emphasizing the foundational role of reverence for God in acquiring wisdom.

questions.question: What does the heart of the righteous do, according to Proverbs 15:28?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:28 states, 'The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things', showing the careful consideration that the righteous give to their responses.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:27, what happens to a house when someone is greedy of gain?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:27 explains, 'He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live', indicating that greed can lead to strife and issues within one's household.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 15:18, a wrathful man stirs up strife.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:18 states, 'A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife', confirming the truth of the statement.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:25 say about the house of the proud?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:25 reveals, 'The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow', highlighting the fate of pridefulness.

questions.question: True or False: The mouth of fools is said to pour out wisdom in Proverbs 15:28.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:28 indicates that 'the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things', not wisdom, clarifying that fools do not speak wisely.

questions.question: Which verse connects the idea of a wise son making a father glad?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:20 states that 'A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother', emphasizing the joy that a wise son brings to his father.

questions.question: What literary device is evident in Proverbs 15:32, contrasting instruction and despising one's soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:32 exhibits parallelism by contrasting 'He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul' with 'he that heareth reproof getteth understanding', which emphasizes the two opposing responses to instruction.

questions.question: Which Old Testament book shares a theme of the importance of wise counsel, similar to Proverbs 15:22?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 4:9-12 highlights the value of companionship and counsel, resonating with Proverbs 15:22's affirmation that 'Without counsel purposes are disappointed'.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reinforces the idea of the prayer of the righteous being heard, as stated in Proverbs 15:29?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:12 affirms that 'the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers', reinforcing the sentiment of Proverbs 15:29.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 15 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 15 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:1 teach about the nature of communication?
options: A soft answer can defuse anger
Words have no impact on relationships
questions.correctAnswer: A soft answer can defuse anger
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:1 states that 'A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger,' indicating that gentle communication can resolve conflict.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:7, what is the characteristic of the wise and foolish?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:7 teaches that 'The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so,' highlighting the role of wise individuals in sharing understanding.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:9 reveal about God's view on righteousness?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:9 states, 'The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness,' indicating God's favor towards those who pursue righteousness.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:11, what is always before the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:11 indicates that 'Hell and destruction are before the LORD,' which emphasizes God's omniscience regarding the fate of all individuals.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:25 tell us about pride and humility?
options: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:25 states, 'The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow,' illustrating God's opposition to pride.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:18 teach about anger and conflict?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:18 teaches that 'A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife,' highlighting the value of patience in resolving conflict.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 15:22 relate to the importance of counsel?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:22 asserts that 'Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established,' emphasizing the wisdom in seeking guidance.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 15:13 and 15:15 convey about the heart's condition?
options: A merry heart leads to sorrow
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:13 states, 'A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken,' while verse 15 emphasizes joy in the heart as a continual feast.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:30 indicate about the impact of good news?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:30 states, 'The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat,' illustrating how positive news uplifts the spirit.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 15:28 describe the heart of the righteous?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:28 highlights that 'The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things,' emphasizing the careful consideration of the righteous.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:12 indicate about the scorner's attitude towards reproof?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:12 states that 'A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise,' indicating a disdain for correction.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 15:6, what is the outcome of living righteously?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:6 teaches that 'In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble,' affirming the blessings of a righteous life.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 15:14 reveal about the pursuits of understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:14 states, 'The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness,' highlighting the proactive pursuit of wisdom.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 15:3 illustrate God's omnipresence?
options: God is only present with the righteous
God sees both evil and good
questions.correctAnswer: God sees both evil and good
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:3 states, 'The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good,' emphasizing God's awareness of all human actions.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that God does not care about the actions of humanity. What does Proverbs 15:29 teach?
options: God is far from the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: God is far from the wicked
questions.explanation: Proverbs 15:29 affirms that 'The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous,' highlighting God's engagement with humanity based on their moral standing.
